SELECT c.documento AS c_documento, c.nombre AS c_nombre, c.telefono AS c_telefono, c.direccion AS c_direccion, c.email AS c_email, c.vetado AS c_vetado,
ir.id AS ir_id, ir.fechainiciorenta || ' 00:00:00.000' AS ir_fechainiciorenta, ir.fechafinrenta || ' 00:00:00.000' AS ir_fechafinrenta,
i.id AS ir_i_id, i.nombre AS ir_i_nombre, i.descripcion AS ir_i_descripcion, i.fechalanzamiento || ' 00:00:00.000' AS ir_i_fechalanzamiento, i.tarifaxdia AS ir_i_tarifaxdia, i.formatorenta AS ir_i_formatorenta, i.genero AS ir_i_genero,
ti.id AS ir_i_ti_id, ti.descripcion AS ir_i_ti_descripcion
FROM VI_CLIENTES c LEFT JOIN VI_ITEMRENTADO ir ON c.documento = ir.CLIENTES_documento LEFT JOIN VI_ITEMS i ON ir.ITEMS_id = i.id LEFT JOIN VI_TIPOITEM ti ON i.TIPOITEM_id = ti.id
